name: Cloud Bazaar of Scented Breezes
description: A floating bazaar composed of pastel clouds, where stalls sell bundles of scented breezes, shimmering dust, and liquid moonlight in glass vials.
prompt: Bazaar built from soft pastel clouds, stalls offering jars of glowing breeze, shimmering dust, liquid moonlight, gentle rays of sun filtering through, hyperrealistic, whimsical market atmosphere, no text, vibrant colors.
caption: Trade in the sky—buy breezes, moonlight, and stardust from clouds that drift just above your reach.
